# Xiletrade

> Free, open-source price check overlay for Path of Exile (PoE 1) and Path of Exile 2, for Windows. Hover an item in game, press a hotkey (Ctrl+D by default) and Xiletrade shows estimated prices based on the official PoE trade websites.

Key facts:
- Platform: Windows 64-bit (win-x64 build). Portable .7z archive, nothing to install.
- Games: Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2.
- Cost and license: free and open source (GPLv3).
- Languages: supports all Path of Exile client languages. The website exists in 11 languages (en, fr, de, es, pt-BR, ru, th, ko, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant).
- Footprint: low CPU usage, max 250 MB of RAM, no data written in the background.
- Requirement: the game must run in windowed or borderless full screen mode.
- First released in 2020, maintained by maxensas.

## Main features
- Price check of any item with a hotkey (Ctrl+D by default); settings window with Ctrl+R.
- Bulk item exchange for fast whisper trades.
- Addons linked to poe.prices, poe.ninja, PoE Wiki and poedb.
- Update check and filter refresh on startup.
- Hotkeys for chat console messages and mouse wheel / left click binding, following the single action rule of the PoE third-party policy as stated by the project.
- Regex manager utility.
- Designed to limit requests to the official trade website and warns when limits are approached.

## FAQ
- Is it safe to download from another site? Download only from the GitHub repository or this github.io website.
- Can it get me banned? The maintainer states that the version published on this site complies with the game publisher's third-party policy; the publisher does not guarantee any third-party tool, so read the policy: https://www.pathofexile.com/developer/docs#policy
- Why is it free? It is standalone software without advertisements; donations are optional.
